skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the unique characteristics of the sales profession and sales activities.
Understand the qualities and characteristics of salespeople.
Understand the knowledge salespeople need to have to support sales activities.
Understand the sales process and the behavior of salespeople in the sales process.
Understand the principles of basic communication skills.
Understand how to communicate effectively in sales.
Understand how to follow up and serve customers after sales.
Understand the tasks that salespeople need to perform throughout the sales process.
Apply acquired knowledge to analyze specific sales situations.
Evaluate sales methods in various real situations and provide sales guidance for specific products/services.
Propose sales scripts for specific products/services in specific situations.
Apply sales skills to communicate effectively in sales situations.
Apply independent and team work skills to develop sales scripts for specific products/services in specific situations.
